source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 3 (2020), no. 3, 593-602; DOI 10.5802/alco.105; publisher native TeX
difficulty_reason: After standard Bruhat order, Schubert polynomial, and RC-graph prerequisites, the proof must construct a multi-stage sign-reversing involution on special RC-graphs, including modified flip moves across empty rows. It then proves uniqueness of the nonflippable bottom RC-graph and derives the signed Vandermonde formula, a global cancellation and uniqueness argument beyond ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
